headings.h3: text-xl md:text-2xl text-[#D4AF37] font-sans uppercase tracking-[0.2em]

layout_and_spacing.generous_spacing: Sections should be at least 100vh to 200vh tall to allow proper scroll-driven storytelling. Use generous padding to let the imagery breathe.

motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Framer Motion for staggered text reveals and simple UI hovers
motion_and_interactions.dove_animation: Fixed dove element with GSAP mapping to scroll progress. Dove moves across the screen and scales down/fades out in Act 4.
motion_and_interactions.parchment_reveal: GSAP scaleY from center, unrolling effect when dove lands in Act 4.
motion_and_interactions.particles: CSS or Framer Motion floating golden dots moving slowly upwards to simulate magical fireflies/sunrays across Act 1 and Act 2.
motion_and_interactions.ripple_effect: CSS radial gradient burst on click/touch in The Journey scene (Act 3).

media_assets.audio: Indian flute/sitar ambient track (simulate with a placeholder audio URL or just visual toggle for now).

components.audio_toggle: Fixed top right, z-50. Gold icon (Lucide Volume2 / VolumeX) with subtle glowing ring on hover. `data-testid='audio-toggle'`
components.skip_to_details: Fixed bottom right, z-50. Subtle gold text underline, 'Skip to Details'. `data-testid='skip-button'`
components.cta_buttons: Gold border (#D4AF37), transparent background, solid gold on hover with dark text (#0B1A14). Sharp edges with 1px border. Font: Outfit uppercase tracking-widest. `data-testid='cta-button'`
components.parchment_card: Center screen in Act 4. Soft shadow, gold border accents. Text is dark green (#0B1A14). Contains details: Bhumika Darbar & Arpit Patel, Date, Time, Venue.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALL and configure 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This is critical for the cinematic storytelling.
INSTALL 'gsap' (with ScrollTrigger) for timeline animations and overarching scroll control.
INSTALL 'framer-motion' for staggered text reveals within sections.
IMPORT Google Fonts: 'Cormorant Garamond' (weights 400,600,700) and 'Outfit' (weights 300,400,600). DO NOT use Inter.
Act 1: Awakening Forest. Use awakening_forest_bg. Overlay dark green. Implement floating gold particles. Stagger text: 'A tale of two souls...'
Act 2: Divine Messenger. Introduce the divine_messenger_dove (absolute fixed image with z-index 50). Use GSAP ScrollTrigger so the dove moves downwards and across the screen as user scrolls.
Act 3: The Journey. Transition background to journey_river and journey_temple. Add a subtle ripple interaction effect when clicking on the river section.
Act 4: The Reveal. Dove 'lands' (stops moving, scales down). reveal_parchment image fades in. Display the invitation details on top of the parchment (Bhumika & Arpit, 10th May 2026, 3:00 PM, Venue).
Act 5: Ending. Background changes to ending_lanterns (night sky). Show the CTAs 'View Location' (https://share.google/GOfs4sIcSrrG3Gx7o) and 'Add to Calendar'.
Add 'data-testid' to interactive elements (mute, skip, CTA buttons).
Ensure maximum contrast. Do NOT use purple or teal. Stick strictly to deep forest green, midnight blue, and gold.
Make the experience mobile-first, ensuring texts and backgrounds fit within vertical viewports properly like an Instagram Reel.
Do not use Shadcn for the main layouts. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the cinematic sections.
